summary: Sandbach United are just one week away from kick-off in the 26/27 campaign, coming off a competitive friendly against St Helens where they narrowly lost despite both sides playing well. The club has been busy preparing for the new season with three brand new kits and exciting new squad additions, plus a returning player to bolster the roster. With promotion in their sights, the Ramblers are also actively seeking sponsorship opportunities to support their ambitious campaign ahead.
